name: USAvionix Website Design
summary: Website design showcase of the USAvionix UAV site: a dark, cinematic 3D landing page with layered scroll animation.
description: landing.love's feature on the USAvionix site, with screenshots and a full recording. The site opens with a cinematic system boot sequence of thermal, lidar and IR readouts, then walks through three mission scenarios on a pure black canvas with crisp white type.
